name: The Westin Philadelphia
positioning: A Center City hotel at Liberty Place, between City Hall and Rittenhouse Square, with marble bathrooms, family-sized suites and pet-friendly rooms
best_for: Travelers wanting a Center City base between City Hall and Rittenhouse Square
Convention Center visitors who want to walk there

facts.text: The hotel is at 99 South 17th Street at Liberty Place.
Lea Restaurant & Bar uses regionally sourced ingredients, with seasonal menus and cocktails influenced by the city's history.
Room service is available 24 hours a day.
The hotel has a WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio.
All rooms and suites have thick terry robes and complimentary bath products.
Rooms have the Westin Heavenly Bed.
Rooms have smart TVs with premium cable channels.
The hotel is certified under the Green Key Eco-Rating Program.

highlights.text: The hotel is located between City Hall and Rittenhouse Square.
Suites have extended living areas suited to family stays.
The Franklin Institute and the Pennsylvania Convention Center are a 10-minute walk away.
Every room at the hotel welcomes pets.

considerations.text: This is a downtown city hotel; Independence Hall is 1.3 miles away rather than next door.
WhataHotel notes valet parking is required in the busy Center City area.
